title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,101–2,150 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Cutting-edge green technology reduces industrial carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 前瞻尖端的綠色科技有效降低了工業碳排放。

examples.en: Advancements in medical technology have extended average human life expectancy.
examples.zh: 醫療技術的進步延長了人類的平均預期壽命。

examples.en: Many schools incorporate educational technology into their daily curricula.
examples.zh: 許多學校已將教育科技融入日常課程教學中。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence revolutionizes medical diagnosis and automated translation.
examples.zh: 人工智慧徹底革新了醫療診斷與自動翻譯領域。

examples.en: Ethical guidelines are needed to govern the rapid development of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 需要制定道德倫理準則以規範人工智慧的快速發展。

examples.en: Many software applications now integrate generative artificial intelligence features.
examples.zh: 許多應用軟體現在都整合了生成式人工智慧的功能。

examples.en: Machine learning models predict traffic congestion patterns accurately.
examples.zh: 機器學習模型能精準預測道路交通壅塞模式。

examples.en: She is taking an online course to understand the fundamentals of machine learning.
examples.zh: 她正在修習線上課程以理解機器學習的基本原理。

examples.en: Financial institutions rely on machine learning to detect credit card fraud.
examples.zh: 金融機構依賴機器學習來偵測信用卡詐騙交易。

examples.en: Social media feeds use sorting algorithms to recommend relevant video content.
examples.zh: 社群動態牆運用排序演算法向用戶推薦相關影片內容。

examples.en: The search engine updated its core algorithm to filter out low-quality websites.
examples.zh: 該搜尋引擎更新了核心演算法以過濾低品質網站。

examples.en: Engineers are developing a faster algorithm to process large datasets.
examples.zh: 工程師正在開發更快速的演算法來處理龐大的資料集。

examples.en: Keep your antivirus software updated to defend against malicious attacks.
examples.zh: 保持防毒軟體即時更新以抵禦惡意網路攻擊。

examples.en: Our company decided to switch to open-source software to save licensing costs.
examples.zh: 我們公司決定轉換至開源軟體以節省授權費用。

examples.en: The new graphic editing software offers dozens of intuitive drawing tools.
examples.zh: 這款全新的影像編輯軟體提供了數十種直覺好用的繪圖工具。

examples.en: Taiwan is a worldwide leader in PC and server hardware manufacturing.
examples.zh: 台灣在個人電腦與伺服器硬體製造領域領先全球。

examples.en: You should upgrade your computer hardware before playing graphic-intensive games.
examples.zh: 在玩高畫質遊戲之前，你應該先升級電腦硬體規格。

examples.en: The tech store sells both computer hardware and specialized repair tools.
examples.zh: 這家科技商店兼賣電腦硬體與專業維修工具。

words.definition: 軟體開發者；程式設計師；建商

examples.en: App developers gathered at the annual international hackathon competition.
examples.zh: 應用程式開發者齊聚於一年一度的國際黑客松競賽。

examples.en: The senior developer spent the afternoon reviewing code written by interns.
examples.zh: 資深軟體開發工程師花了一整個下午審查實習生編寫的程式碼。

examples.en: A local property developer plans to build a new shopping complex downtown.
examples.zh: 當地一家不動產建商計劃在市中心興建一座新的購物商場。

examples.en: Python is one of the most popular programming languages for beginners.
examples.zh: Python 是最受初學者歡迎的熱門程式設計語言之一。

examples.en: Logical thinking skills can be greatly sharpened through computer programming.
examples.zh: 透過電腦程式設計能大幅鍛鍊邏輯思考能力。

examples.en: The museum organized a weekend programming workshop for teenagers.
examples.zh: 博物館為青少年舉辦了一場週末程式設計工作坊。

examples.en: Customer contact information is safely stored in an encrypted database.
examples.zh: 顧客聯絡資訊被安全妥善地儲存在加密資料庫中。

examples.en: The server administrator backed up the relational database before the system upgrade.
examples.zh: 伺服器管理員在系統升級前將關聯式資料庫進行了備份。

examples.en: Researchers queried the medical database to analyze disease prevalence across regions.
examples.zh: 研究人員查詢醫療資料庫以分析各區域的疾病盛行率。

examples.en: High-performance cloud servers host millions of active websites.
examples.zh: 高效能雲端伺服器託管著數以百萬計的活躍網站。

examples.en: A sudden surge in web traffic caused the ticketing server to go offline.
examples.zh: 網路流量突然暴增導致購票伺服器連線中斷。

examples.en: The polite server recommended the chef's special dish of the day.
examples.zh: 那位有禮貌的服務生推薦了今日主廚特餐。

examples.en: Store your study notes on cloud storage so you can access them anywhere.
examples.zh: 將你的讀書筆記存放在雲端硬碟，方便隨時隨地查閱。

examples.en: Many cloud storage providers offer free limited space for basic users.
examples.zh: 許多雲端儲存服務商為一般用戶提供免費的有限空間。

examples.en: Automated synchronization with cloud storage prevents accidental data loss.
examples.zh: 與雲端儲存自動同步能防止檔案因意外而遺失。

examples.en: Cloud computing allows enterprises to scale computing power dynamically.
examples.zh: 雲端運算使企業能夠動態擴展靈活強大的運算效能。

examples.en: The rise of cloud computing has transformed traditional corporate IT infrastructure.
examples.zh: 雲端運算的興起翻轉了傳統企業的資訊科技基礎架構。

examples.en: Cost reduction and flexibility are major incentives for adopting cloud computing.
examples.zh: 降低成本與彈性是企業導入雲端運算的主要誘因。

examples.en: Financial institutions invest heavily in advanced cybersecurity systems.
examples.zh: 金融機構投入巨資建構先進嚴密的網路資安防護系統。

examples.en: The seminar emphasized the importance of individual cybersecurity awareness.
examples.zh: 該講座強調了培養個人網路資安防範意識的重要性。

examples.en: A major cybersecurity breach forced the company to reset all passwords.
examples.zh: 一起重大資安外洩事件迫使該公司重設所有密碼。

examples.en: Ethical white-hat hackers help organizations identify security vulnerabilities.
examples.zh: 合法具道德感的白帽駭客協助企業組織找出安全漏洞。

examples.en: The notorious hacker was arrested after breaking into government databases.
examples.zh: 惡名昭彰的駭客在入侵政府資料庫後遭到逮捕。

examples.en: Security teams must think like a hacker to anticipate potential threats.
examples.zh: 資安團隊必須以駭客的思維思考才能預防潛在威脅。

examples.en: Never download suspicious email attachments that could contain a computer virus.
examples.zh: 切勿下載可能夾帶電腦病毒的可疑電子郵件附件。

examples.en: The seasonal flu virus spreads rapidly in crowded indoor environments.
examples.zh: 季節性流感病毒在擁擠的室內環境中傳播迅速。

examples.en: Running a complete system scan discovered a dormant Trojan virus.
examples.zh: 執行全系統掃描發現了一隻潛伏的木馬病毒。

examples.en: The IT team installed patches to block dangerous malware infections.
examples.zh: 資訊部門安裝了安全修補程式以阻擋危險惡意軟體的感染。

examples.en: Downloading pirated software often introduces spyware and malware onto your PC.
examples.zh: 下載盜版軟體常會將間諜軟體與惡意軟體引入個人電腦。

examples.en: Modern antivirus solutions detect malware by analyzing anomalous file behaviors.
examples.zh: 現代防毒軟體透過分析異常檔案行為來偵測惡意軟體。

examples.en: Ransomware attacks lock files until the victim pays a crypto ransom.
examples.zh: 勒索軟體攻擊會鎖死檔案，直到受害者支付加密貨幣贖金。

examples.en: Hospitals are frequent targets of ransomware extortion schemes.
examples.zh: 醫院常成為勒索軟體勒索企圖的目標攻擊對象。

examples.en: Maintaining offline backup copies is the most reliable defense against ransomware.
examples.zh: 保存離線備份副本是抵禦勒索軟體最可靠的防線。

examples.en: Beware of fake phishing text messages claiming your parcel is delayed.
examples.zh: 當心假借包裹配送延誤為由的假冒釣魚簡訊詐騙。

examples.en: The company conducts regular phishing simulation drills for its employees.
examples.zh: 公司為員工定期舉辦釣魚郵件模擬演練。

examples.en: Phishing websites imitate banking portals to steal login credentials.
examples.zh: 釣魚網站模仿銀行登入入口以竊取使用者的帳密憑證。

examples.en: A robust enterprise firewall filters unauthorized network traffic.
examples.zh: 堅固的企業級防火牆能有效過濾未經授權的網路流量。

examples.en: Make sure your personal firewall is turned on whenever connecting to public Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 連線至公共 Wi-Fi 時，請確保個人防火牆已開啟。

examples.en: The network engineer adjusted the firewall rules to allow remote access.
examples.zh: 網路工程師調整了防火牆規則以允許遠端連線訪問。

examples.en: Messaging apps encrypt user chats end-to-end for privacy.
examples.zh: 通訊軟體對使用者的通話聊天進行端對端加密以保護隱私。

examples.en: You should encrypt confidential business contracts before emailing them.
examples.zh: 在透過電子郵件寄出機密商業合約前應先進行加密。

examples.en: The device uses advanced algorithms to encrypt stored biometric data.
examples.zh: 該裝置採用先進演算法對儲存的生物特徵數據進行加密。

examples.en: SSL encryption secures credit card numbers during online transactions.
examples.zh: SSL 加密技術確保了線上刷卡交易時信用卡號的安全。

examples.en: Without proper decryption keys, the strongest encryption cannot be broken.
examples.zh: 若沒有正確的解密金鑰，最強的加密演算法也無法被破解。

examples.en: Privacy advocates support default encryption on personal electronic devices.
examples.zh: 隱私倡導者支持在個人電子設備上預設啟用加密功能。

examples.en: Create a strong password combining uppercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
examples.zh: 建立一個結合大寫英文字母、數字與特殊符號的強式密碼。

examples.en: I forgot my account password and requested a password reset link.
examples.zh: 我忘記了帳號密碼，並索取了密碼重設連結。

examples.en: Never share your online banking password with anyone over the phone.
examples.zh: 絕不要在電話中將網路銀行密碼透露給任何人。

examples.en: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on your bank account for safety.
examples.zh: 為您的銀行帳戶啟用雙重身分驗證（2FA）以確保資金安全。

examples.en: Two-factor authentication requires both your password and a verification code.
examples.zh: 雙重身分驗證需要輸入密碼以及手機驗證碼。

examples.en: Adding two-factor authentication drastically reduces the chance of account takeover.
examples.zh: 加入雙重身分驗證能大幅降低帳號遭盜用的機率。

words.definition: 生物辨識的；生物特徵的

examples.en: Modern border control gates use biometric passport scanning technology.
examples.zh: 現代化機場自動通關閘道採用生物辨識護照掃描技術。

examples.en: Biometric authentication methods include fingerprint scanners and iris recognition.
examples.zh: 生物特徵辨識方式包括指紋掃描機與虹膜識別。

examples.en: High-security facilities rely on biometric access control to prevent intrusion.
examples.zh: 高規格安全機構仰賴生物特徵門禁管制以防止未經授權闖入。

examples.en: Unlock your smartphone swiftly using instant fingerprint recognition.
examples.zh: 使用秒速指紋辨識功能快速將智慧型手機解鎖。

examples.en: Fingerprint recognition sensors are often embedded beneath the smartphone screen.
examples.zh: 指紋辨識感測器通常嵌入於智慧型手機螢幕下方。

examples.en: Wet fingers can sometimes hinder the accuracy of fingerprint recognition.
examples.zh: 手指潮濕有時會影響指紋辨識的精準度。

examples.en: Facial recognition allows hands-free payment and building access.
examples.zh: 人臉辨識技術實現了免動手刷臉支付與大樓門禁進出。

examples.en: Some cities test facial recognition cameras in train stations for public safety.
examples.zh: 部分城市在火車站測試人臉辨識監視器以維護公共安全。

examples.en: Privacy critics voice concerns over mass surveillance via facial recognition.
examples.zh: 隱私倡導團體對透過人臉辨識進行大規模監控表示擔憂。

examples.en: Install system updates regularly to receive performance fixes.
examples.zh: 定期安裝系統更新以獲得效能優化與修補程式。

examples.en: The project manager sent a weekly progress update to all stakeholders.
examples.zh: 專案經理向所有利害關係人寄送了每週進度更新報告。

examples.en: You need to update your address on the official portal after moving.
examples.zh: 搬家後，你需要至官方入口網站更新戶籍聯絡地址。

examples.en: We decided to upgrade our home broadband to high-speed fiber optics.
examples.zh: 我們決定將家中的寬頻上網升級為高速光纖網路。

examples.en: The flight was overbooked, so the airline offered to upgrade our seats to business class.
examples.zh: 該航班機位超賣，航空公司便主動將我們的座位升等為商務艙。

examples.en: Upgrading your graphics card will significantly improve video rendering times.
examples.zh: 升級獨立顯示卡將能顯著縮短影片算圖輸出時間。

examples.en: Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS are mainstream operating systems.
examples.zh: Windows、macOS、Android 與 iOS 是主流作業系統。

examples.en: An operating system manages computer hardware and executes user software programs.
examples.zh: 作業系統負責管理電腦硬體資源並執行使用者應用程式。

examples.en: Linux is the preferred operating system for web servers worldwide.
examples.zh: Linux 是全球網路伺服器最普遍偏好採用的作業系統。

examples.en: Clear your web browser cache if web pages fail to load correctly.
examples.zh: 若網頁無法正常載入顯示，請嘗試清除網路瀏覽器快取。

examples.en: Most modern web browsers support private browsing and custom extensions.
examples.zh: 多數現代網路瀏覽器皆支援無痕隱私瀏覽與自訂擴充套件。

examples.en: The browser crashed when I attempted to stream three videos at once.
examples.zh: 當我試圖同時串流播放三部影片時，瀏覽器當機了。

examples.en: The newly redesigned user interface is intuitive and clean.
examples.zh: 重新改版設計的使用者介面十分直覺且乾淨俐落。

examples.en: Programmers interact with cloud services using an application programming interface (API).
examples.zh: 程式設計師透過應用程式介面（API）與雲端服務進行互動溝通。

examples.en: The audio interface connects professional microphones directly to a laptop.
examples.zh: 這款音訊介面（錄音卡）可將專業麥克風直接連接至筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Optimizing app load speed greatly enhances user experience.
examples.zh: 優化應用程式的載入開啟速度能大幅提升使用者體驗。

examples.en: Designers conduct in-depth interviews to understand the customer user experience.
examples.zh: 設計師進行深度訪談以了解消費者的實際使用者體驗。

examples.en: Confusing navigation buttons create a frustrating user experience for shoppers.
examples.zh: 令人困惑的導覽按鈕會給購物顧客帶來挫折的使用者體驗。

words.definition: 頻寬；網路速度；個人心力負荷

examples.en: Streaming 4K movies requires sufficient internet network bandwidth.
examples.zh: 串流播放 4K 高畫質電影需要充裕順暢的網路頻寬。

examples.en: The internet service provider throttled our bandwidth during peak evening hours.
examples.zh: 網路服務業者在晚間尖峰時段限制了我們的頻寬速率。

examples.en: I don't have enough mental bandwidth to take on another project this week.
examples.zh: 我這週實在沒有多餘的心力負荷再去接下另一項專案。

examples.en: Taiwan boasts one of the world's most accessible fiber broadband networks.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有全球普及率最高的光纖寬頻上網環境之一。

examples.en: Fast broadband connectivity is essential for families working and studying from home.
examples.zh: 高速寬頻連線對於在家工作與學習的家庭而言至關重要。

examples.en: The telecom company rolled out affordable broadband packages for students.
examples.zh: 電信公司針對學生族群推出了實惠經濟的寬頻專案。

examples.en: You can turn your smartphone into a portable Wi-Fi personal hotspot.
examples.zh: 您可以將智慧型手機轉換為隨身可攜式的 Wi-Fi 個人熱點。

examples.en: Free public Wi-Fi hotspots are available at most MRT stations and cafes.
examples.zh: 多數捷運站與咖啡廳均提供免費公共 Wi-Fi 熱點。

examples.en: That coastal cafe has become a popular tourist hotspot on Instagram.
examples.zh: 那家濱海咖啡廳已成為 Instagram 上熱門的觀光打卡熱點。

examples.en: 5G technology offers ultra-fast data speeds and seamless IoT connectivity.
examples.zh: 5G 科技提供了極速傳輸與物聯網無縫連網能力。

examples.en: The remote mountain cabin had poor mobile connectivity.
examples.zh: 那座深山小木屋的手機行動網路連線訊號極差。

examples.en: Bluetooth connectivity allows the earbuds to link with two devices at once.
examples.zh: 藍牙連線功能允許耳機同時配對連結兩台設備。

examples.en: A brief technical glitch caused the online registration to freeze.
examples.zh: 短暫的技術小故障導致線上報名系統出現畫面卡頓。

examples.en: The development team promptly resolved the audio glitch in the video game.
examples.zh: 開發團隊迅速修復了電子遊戲中的音訊異常小毛病。

examples.en: Aside from a minor software glitch, the launch event ran smoothly.
examples.zh: 除了微小的軟體小毛病外，發表會進行得非常順利。

examples.en: Programmers worked through the night to fix the critical software bug.
examples.zh: 程式設計師徹夜奮戰以修復關鍵的軟體程式錯誤。

examples.en: Users discovered an unexpected bug that caused the app to close abruptly.
examples.zh: 使用者發現了一個導致應用程式突然閃退的意外錯誤。

examples.en: A thorough testing phase helps detect nasty software bugs before release.
examples.zh: 全面的測試階段有助於在軟體發布前找出棘手的程式漏洞。

examples.en: Developers use specialized testing tools to debug computer code.
examples.zh: 開發人員使用專業的測試工具來為電腦程式碼進行除錯。

examples.en: It took hours of patient debugging to trace the root cause of the memory leak.
examples.zh: 花費了數小時耐心除錯才追查出記憶體洩漏的根本原因。

examples.en: Before shipping new features, engineers thoroughly test and debug every component.
examples.zh: 在交付新功能之前，工程師會徹底測試並為每個模組元件除錯。

examples.en: Always make an automated external backup of your important thesis files.
examples.zh: 務必為重要的畢業論文檔案建立自動化的外部硬碟備份。

examples.en: The hospital operates backup generators in case of electrical power failure.
examples.zh: 醫院備有備用發電機以防遭遇電力中斷。

examples.en: If our primary supplier cannot fulfill the order, we have a reliable backup ready.
examples.zh: 若主要供應商無法交貨，我們已準備好了可靠的備用方案。

examples.en: You can restore all photos from your cloud account to the new phone.
examples.zh: 你可以將雲端帳戶中的所有照片完整還原至新手機上。

examples.en: The IT specialist managed to restore corrupted database files after the crash.
examples.zh: 資訊專員在當機事故後成功修復並還原了損毀的資料庫檔案。

examples.en: The community raised funds to restore the historic town hall.
examples.zh: 社區募集資金以修復重建這座歷史悠久的市政廳建築。

examples.en: Try rebooting your Wi-Fi router to resolve slow internet speeds.
examples.zh: 嘗試將 Wi-Fi 無線路由器重新開機以解決網路連線緩慢問題。

examples.en: The operating system prompt instructed the user to reboot the laptop.
examples.zh: 作業系統畫面提示使用者將筆記型電腦重新開機。

examples.en: A brief walk outside helped reboot his exhausted brain.
examples.zh: 到戶外散個步有助於讓他疲憊的腦袋重新開機。

examples.en: The browser crashed unexpectedly when I opened thirty tabs at once.
examples.zh: 當我一口氣打開三十個分頁時，瀏覽器突然當機閃退了。

examples.en: Thankfully, nobody was seriously injured in the minor highway car crash.
examples.zh: 萬幸的是，這起高速公路輕微車禍相撞事故無人重傷。

examples.en: Investors panicked when stock market prices took a dramatic crash.
examples.zh: 當股市行情發生戲劇性暴跌時，投資人陷入恐慌。

examples.en: The computer screen froze while playing the high-definition 3D game.
examples.zh: 在遊玩高畫質 3D 遊戲時，電腦螢幕畫面突然卡住不動。

examples.en: Water pipes can freeze and burst when winter temperatures drop below zero.
examples.zh: 冬季氣溫驟降至零度以下時，水管可能會結冰破裂。

examples.en: The government announced plans to freeze public transport fares this year.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了今年凍結大眾運輸票價的計劃。

examples.en: This USB-C charging cable is compatible with all modern smartphones.
examples.zh: 這條 Type-C 充電線與所有現代智慧型手機皆完全相容。

examples.en: The new software suite is fully compatible with older operating systems.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體套件與舊版作業系統完全相容。

examples.en: They make a great couple because their personalities and goals are highly compatible.
examples.zh: 他們是非常般配的情侶，因為性格與人生目標非常契合。

examples.en: The old graphic software is incompatible with the latest operating system.
examples.zh: 這套老舊的繪圖軟體與最新的作業系統版本並不相容。

examples.en: Their differing work styles made them fundamentally incompatible as business partners.
examples.zh: 他們不同的做事風格使他們在商業合作夥伴關係上根本合不來。

examples.en: Incompatible file formats prevented the program from importing the dataset.
examples.zh: 不相容的檔案格式導致程式無法匯入該資料集。

examples.en: Smart wearable devices track your heart rate and sleep patterns.
examples.zh: 智慧穿戴裝置能即時追蹤您的心率與睡眠週期模式。

examples.en: Please switch off all electronic devices during airplane takeoff and landing.
examples.zh: 飛機起飛與降落期間請關閉所有電子裝置設備。

examples.en: The inventor designed a clever mechanical device to peel apples rapidly.
examples.zh: 發明家設計了一款能快速削蘋果皮的巧妙機械裝置。

words.definition: 電腦周邊設備（鍵鼠、螢幕）；周圍的

examples.en: Keyboards, mice, and webcams are essential computer peripherals.
examples.zh: 鍵盤、滑鼠與網路攝影機是不可或缺的電腦周邊設備。

examples.en: He plugged several external peripherals into the multi-port USB hub.
examples.zh: 他將數個外部周邊配件插上了多功能 USB 集線器。

examples.en: Let us focus on the core argument rather than getting distracted by peripheral issues.
examples.zh: 讓我們聚焦於核心論點，而不要被次要周邊瑣事分散了注意力。

words.definition: 精通科技的；熟悉 3C 產品的

examples.en: Young tech-savvy students adopt new digital tools effortlessly.
examples.zh: 熟悉科技 3C 的年輕學生能毫不費力地快速上手全新數位工具。

examples.en: Companies actively recruit tech-savvy talent to drive automated workflows.
examples.zh: 企業積極招募精通數位科技的人才以推動工作流程自動化。

examples.en: My grandmother became remarkably tech-savvy after receiving an iPad.
examples.zh: 我祖母收到一台 iPad 後變得對 3C 科技產品非常精通。

examples.en: Traditional industries embrace digital transformation to boost productivity.
examples.zh: 傳統產業積極推動數位轉型以大幅提升營運生產力。

examples.en: Cloud adoption and data analytics are central pillars of corporate digital transformation.
examples.zh: 導入雲端技術與數據分析是企業數位轉型的核心支柱。

examples.en: Successful digital transformation requires cultural change alongside technological upgrades.
examples.zh: 成功的數位轉型除了科技升級之外，更需要組織文化的變革配合。
